[[Nicholas the Traveler]] | commonsalvage = 1 [[Granite Slab]] | render = [[File:Glacial Stone.jpg|150px]] }} [[Icy Lodestone]]s are the frosty stone remnants of [[Elemental]] creatures composed of ice. == Acquisition == * [[Guild Wars Prophecies|Prophecies]] ** [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)]] *** [[Ice Elemental (pre-Searing)|Ice Elemental]] ** [[Northern Shiverpeaks]] *** [[Ice Golem]] ** [[Southern Shiverpeaks]] *** Ice Golem *** [[Siege Ice Golem]] * [[Guild Wars Eye of the North|Eye of the North]] ** [[Ice Cliff Chasms]] *** 7 to 12 can be received from a [[Sack of Random Junk]] given to the player by [[Lieutenant Thackeray]] during his [[Thackeray's Scavenger Hunt | scavenger hunt]]. ''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Icy Lodestone#Drop research|here]].'' ===Farming=== ;[[Traveler's Vale]] Start from Yak's Bend and enter Traveler's Vale. There are many ice elementals to the north and to the center of the map. However the following farming road is a lot faster provided you can [[mule]] the icy lodestones. ;[[Wizard's Folly]] [[File:Farming Icy Lodestones.jpg|250px|right]] Leave Foible's Fair and follow the snowy road up the mountain in Wizard's Folly. There's a cave with 7~8 lvl3 ice elementals on the way to the south (don't go near Aziure). You can kill 3-4 more around the Wizard's tower (not advised, unless you like walking) or go on after the cave toward the west (advised, 4 more close to the cave). The advised run takes 5-8mins and has 20 of the ~24 ice elementals in total on the whole map, all in the snowy landscape. They are highly vulnerable to fire, so using fire magic spells or the fire imp is advised. The farming route is also a good way to farm experience in Pre-Searing at low levels and get [[Enchanted Lodestones]]. == Collectors == {{:Savich/Collector armor}} {{:Nicholas Sandford/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|16th May 2011 and 31st December 2012|Icedome|2 [[Icy Lodestone]]s}} == Notes == * This item is required by [[Imperial Chef Tian]] for his dessert at the annual [[Canthan New Year]] festival. *One of three trophies which are being collected by both Nicholas Sandford in pre-Searing and Nicholas the Traveler after the Searing, the others being [[Charr Carving]]s and [[Red Iris Flower]]s. *They share inventory icon with [[Glacial Stone]]s.
